offering_description.value: CPI manufactures credit, debit and prepaid cards for banks, credit unions, fintechs, processors and prepaid program operators. It combines card design, personalization and fulfillment with a payments platform for instant issuance, mobile wallet provisioning, digital rewards and fraud detection.

quotes.quote: A fully integrated platform that enables banks and fintechs to design, issue, and manage modern payment programs—seamlessly connecting digital experiences with physical card production.
CPI delivers integrated payment solutions that help with banks, fintechs, processors and prepaid programs create secure, seamless experiences across digital and physical payment channels.
